reason: I take the free 15 companies first, and if the list and the messages hold up I sign the pilot, because EUR 500 plus EUR 450 per meeting that actually happened, capped at EUR 3,600, pays back with one new freight account. My sales people only look after existing clients, so I have nobody doing this now anyway.
objection: Our name is the business. If cold emails go out clumsy or too often to shippers in a market we want to enter, we are burned there before we start, and I am the one who answers for the GDPR side. Also, 45 meetings in 2 months for someone else tells me nothing about my niche and country.
would_change_my_mind: If the past client they connect me with is not a real logistics firm in a similar lane, or the 15 sample companies are ones we already know or that obviously do not fit, I walk away.
